title: Unconscious Mind
statement:
Unconscious Mind is inspired by the still emotional worlds of Hidden Tears and Silenced. It translates the quiet introspection of those works into motion — a breathing, shifting field of emotion.

The human face is never still: expressions unfold and dissolve — a smile fades into sorrow, surprise melts into calm, joy cracks into silence. No emotion holds forever; each gives way to the next in a rhythm as uncontrollable as breath.

This work is a meditation on the impermanence of feeling. Through layered transitions and subtle movement, the portrait becomes an emotional landscape — fragile yet alive, constantly transforming.

The viewer witnesses not a fixed identity, but the endless flow of inner states — a reminder that change is the only constant.

Soundtrack: Unconscious Mind (Delta) by Interference — licensed via Artlist.io
